title: Incremental Migration Assistant: staged SDK toggles, comms windows, and rollback playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a repeatable playbook and lightweight Migration Assistant (CLI + Console) to orchestrate staggered API/SDK deprecations. Objectives: minimize customer effort, automate compatibility checks, create templated release notes and in-product prompts, and provide gated rollback. Focus on (1) SDK toggle mechanism for customers to opt into new version, (2) telemetry gating and preflight checks, (3) staged comms windows by cohort, and (4) operational runbooks for fast rollback.

runbook_summary: Staged rollout: 1) Canary cohort (internal + 5 beta customers) with toggle enabled for 2 weeks and automated preflight checks; 2) Self-serve cohort (opt-in via Console) with in-product guidance and migration CLI; 3) Enterprise concierge cohort with Solutions Eng assistance and SLA freeze; 4) Full cutover after 90-day grace window. Each stage includes rollback conditions (error-rate > 3% on compatibility checks, structured-output regression > 1.5% on eval set), telemetry dashboard links, and an on-call rotation for 72h post-cutover.
comm_plan: Weekly cadence: announcement -> 2 weeks technical deep-dive -> 2 week beta -> staged opt-in -> 30/60/90 day reminders. Channels: email, in-product banner, developer changelog, community forum, direct outreach for enterprise customers. Release notes pipeline: PR templates that populate the customer-impact table and embed sample migration steps automatically.
migration_tools: CLI tool (migration-check) that uploads sampled prompts, runs compatibility diffs, and outputs a migration score; Console assistant that shows per-tenant diffs and provides toggle action; Release-notes generator that pulls diffs from migration-check output and creates templated notes.
